items.title: Carol Bash interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2012
items.q: And I was lucky enough to be working with a veteran filmmaker, Stanley Nelson. And he really has been my mentor throughout this process.

ctx.x: Right. Because school is a great foundation for some people, for some people. But really, you’re going to learn this job by doing it. You’re going to make those mistakes in the field. I would say the one key thing that helped me tremendously was having a really great mentor. And I was lucky enough to be working with a veteran filmmaker, Stanley Nelson. And he really has been my mentor throughout this process. I worked with his company, Firelight Media, for a good six or seven years, and it was through working…
Good advice. I was curious about if your film — is Mary Lou Williams your first solo effort?
